Running it
----------
simcity.d88 is a disk image for the Casio FP-1100 with its floppy disk
pack (the uPD765A one).  Put it in the first drive and reset the machine
(or start the emulator with it in the first drive): it boots straight
into the game, with no CP/M or BASIC disk needed.  The image is a
2D disk of 40 cylinders, two sides.

The game takes the screen over from the machine's sub CPU: it uses the
320 x 200 screen in eight colours as a grid of 40 by 25 cells.  There is
no sound.  Cities are saved to and loaded from the same disk, in one of
eight slots after the game itself (so the disk must not be write
protected, and the image file is changed when you save).  The map is
96 x 96 squares and there are no scenarios.

Redrawing the whole screen (opening or leaving the budget, say) takes
about two seconds, and a mini map five or six: the sub CPU is slow.

Keys
----
  Cursor keys     move the cursor one square (shifted: eight)
  O P Q A         left, right, up, down
  Space, Enter    build with the tool
  , .             the previous and next tool
  0 - 9           choose a tool by its number
  H               pause or run
  + -             faster, slower
  M               the next mini map (X goes back to the city)
  B               the budget            V   the evaluation
  S               save the city         L   load a city
  X               the game menu: new city, options, disasters
  Esc             back out of a menu or a question
